name: frontend-design
title_zh: 给新界面定一套不像模板的视觉基调
tagline_zh: 新界面刚起稿、老界面想翻新时，它先逼你定下审美方向再动手：字体层级、留白节奏、色彩态度，每个选择都给出理由。
tagline_en: Before you touch a new UI or restyle an old one, it forces an aesthetic direction first: type scale, spacing.
desc_en: Guidance for distinctive, intentional visual design when building new UI or reshaping an existing one. Helps with aesthetic direction, typography, and making choices that don't read as templated defaults.
why_zh: 它把「好看」拆成可执行的取舍：先定调性再选字体，先定对比再定色板，避免边写边凑出一张谁都能生成的页面。
why_en: It decomposes taste into decisions: tone before typefaces, contrast before palettes — so you don't drift into a page anyone.
limit_zh: 它只给方向、层级和取舍理由，不产出成品代码或 Figma 文件；已有成熟设计系统时它多半在重复你已知的规则。
limit_en: Gives direction, hierarchy and rationale only — no production code or Figma files. With a mature design system it mostly restates what you know, and.
title_en: Set a visual tone for new UI that won't read as a template
